subject: Correct spelling in module cleanup, command docs, source comments, and Tcl tests (#2243)
reason: The change is purely spelling fixes: comments and docs in bitops.c, defrag.c, lolwut5.c, module.c, replication.c, rio.c, server.c, siphash.c, src/commands/README.md and valkey.conf, plus test-name/comment typos in Tcl tests. The only code edit renames the internal function moduleRemoveCateogires to moduleRemoveCategories, updating its one call site in the same file; it is a pure identifier rename with no change to logic, replies, replication, persistence or the module API, so no runtime behavior changed and no scenario is needed.
